cues.en: Let's spend a few minutes talking about neural collaborative filtering.
cues.zh: 花幾分鐘談神經協同過濾。

cues.en: This is a new ish algorithm, but one that's gained a lot of popularity recently.
cues.zh: 演算法算新，最近越來越熱門。

cues.en: So definitely one you want to know about.
cues.zh: 絕對值得知道。

cues.en: The idea here is that we're going to make kind of a hybrid between two different models.
cues.zh: 概念是，混合兩種不同模型。

cues.en: So we're going to combine the strengths of matrix factorization, which goes way back, right?
cues.zh: 結合歷史悠久的矩陣分解優點，對吧？

cues.en: I mean, we talked about that much earlier in the course and also neural networks.
cues.zh: 課程更早談過，也結合神經網路。

cues.en: So kind of combining the strengths of these two things.
cues.zh: 把兩者優點結合。

cues.en: So the problem with matrix factorization is that it can't capture non-linear relationships, whereas neural networks can.
cues.zh: 矩陣分解問題，是無法捕捉非線性關係，神經網路可以。

cues.en: So what if we mash these two things together?
cues.zh: 如果混合呢？

cues.en: You know, matrix factorization is a nice and simple approach, or relatively simple anyway.
cues.zh: 矩陣分解很好、相對簡單。

cues.en: And neural networks, well, they're more complicated, but they can capture those more complex relationships.
cues.zh: 神經網路較複雜，卻能捕捉更複雜關係。

cues.en: So what happens if we put them together?
cues.zh: 放一起會怎樣？

cues.en: So that's what we're doing here in neural collaborative filtering or NCF for short.
cues.zh: 這就是神經協同過濾，簡稱 NCF。

cues.en: So we need to wrap our heads around some acronyms here.
cues.zh: 先理解幾個縮寫。

cues.en: In parallel, we're going to feed our user and item data from our training data.
cues.zh: 平行輸入訓練資料的使用者與項目，

cues.en: You know, these users rated these items this rating through both a generalized matrix factorization model, a GMF, and also a multi-layer perceptron or an MLP.
cues.zh: 也就是這些使用者，給這些項目這些評分，同時通過廣義矩陣分解 GMF，以及多層感知器 MLP。

cues.en: Again, a multilayer perceptron is just a fancy name for a neural network.
cues.zh: 多層感知器，再次只是神經網路的華麗名稱。

cues.en: So in parallel, we're going to feed our users and items through these two different networks, through matrix factorization and a big neural network.
cues.zh: 因此，使用者、項目，平行通過矩陣分解與大型神經網路。

cues.en: So we'll have separate embedding vectors associated with the users and items that are used for each one of these models.
cues.zh: 每種模型，都有各自的使用者與項目嵌入向量。

cues.en: And then when they're done, we feed them together into something called a new layer.
cues.zh: 完成後，一起送入 NeuMF 層。

cues.en: I guess that stands for neural matrix factorization or something.
cues.zh: 我想代表神經矩陣分解之類。

cues.en: All that does is concatenate the results from both the matrix factorization process and the neural network, the MLP process.
cues.zh: 只把矩陣分解與 MLP 神經網路結果串接。

cues.en: After that, we just apply a sigmoid activation function and we get probabilities for what ratings would be for everything else.
cues.zh: 再套 Sigmoid，得到其他評分的機率。

cues.en: So that's all there is to it makes a little bit more sense when you look at a diagram.
cues.zh: 就這樣，看圖更容易理解。

cues.en: So let's start at the bottom here.
cues.zh: 從底部開始。

cues.en: We can see that we have one hot encodings of a user u and an item I that that user implicitly liked or bought or whatever.
cues.zh: 使用者 u，以及他隱含喜歡、購買或其他互動過的項目 i，都以獨熱編碼，

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: And now we're going to create separate embedding layers.
cues.zh: 再建立各自嵌入層。

cues.en: Again, an embedding is just a vector in some multi dimensional space where things that are similar to each other end up close to each other in that space.
cues.zh: 嵌入，就是多維空間向量，相似事物，在空間中靠近。

cues.en: So for the user, we're going to break out a user vector, a user embedding, if you will, for the matrix factorization and also a separate embedding for the neural network, The MLP on the right there.
cues.zh: 使用者，拆出用於矩陣分解的使用者向量或嵌入，以及右側 MLP 的另一個嵌入。

cues.en: Same thing for the items.
cues.zh: 項目相同。

cues.en: We're going to split out an embedding layer for the item vectors for matrix factorization and another embedding for use in the multi-layer perceptron, the neural network on the right there and these get
cues.zh: 拆出用於矩陣分解的項目嵌入，以及右側多層感知器神經網路的另一個嵌入，再

cues.en: combined together, right?
cues.zh: 組合，對吧？

cues.en: So we need to marry the user and item data into these models.
cues.zh: 要把使用者與項目資料，結合到模型。

cues.en: You can see on the left for the generalized matrix factorization layer, we're going to do an element wise product to combine the user embedding and the item embedding for the matrix factorization stack.
cues.zh: 左側 GMF 層，用逐元素相乘，組合使用者與項目嵌入，作為矩陣分解堆疊。

cues.en: Similarly, on the right for the multi-layer Perceptrons, we're going to concatenate the user and item vector embeddings together and feed that into the base of that stack.
cues.zh: 右側 MLP，則串接使用者與項目向量嵌入，送到堆疊底部。

cues.en: And as you can see, you can have many, many of these multi-layer perceptron stacked on top of each other as well to get even more depth to the model.
cues.zh: 可以看到，能堆疊很多多層感知器，讓模型更深。

cues.en: And they just have presumably a Relu activation function between them that's being indicated there.
cues.zh: 這裡表示，中間大概用 ReLU 激活函數。

cues.en: So after we go through that big neural network training and also the matrix factorization, we combine them together, we concatenate those results into the new layer, the neural matrix factorization layer.
cues.zh: 大型神經網路與矩陣分解訓練後，將結果串接到 NeuMF，也就是神經矩陣分解層。

cues.en: From there we assign scores and do a sigmoid activation function.
cues.zh: 再指定分數，套 Sigmoid。

cues.en: And from there we just get predictions of what a given rating might be for a given user and item pair, and that's all there is to it.
cues.zh: 得到某使用者／項目配對可能的評分預測，就這樣。

cues.en: So that's neural collaborative filtering in action.
cues.zh: 這就是神經協同過濾。

cues.en: Conceptually, again, we're just feeding the user and item embeddings through a multi-layer perceptron stack, a stack of deep learning on the right and also a matrix factorization on the left.
cues.zh: 概念上，就是把使用者與項目嵌入，送進右側 MLP 深度學習堆疊，以及左側矩陣分解。

cues.en: And we combine them together with a new layer.
cues.zh: 再以 NeuMF 層結合。

cues.en: That's all there is to it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Pretty simple concept.
cues.zh: 概念相當簡單。

cues.en: So let's talk about how to implement this in practice next.
cues.zh: 下一堂談實務如何實作。
